contract_gaps.multipart_uploads: The current static REST composition serializes JSON body fields and has no multipart form/file construction primitive, so the four multipart upload operations are explicit exclusions.
contract_gaps.regional_server_template: The official OpenAPI server is https://api.{region}.onfido.com/v3.6 for eu, us, and ca. The pack pins a representative EU origin, marks the connection per-org, and keeps /v3.6 binding-owned so enrollment selects the tenant region without caller-controlled routing.
contract_gaps.token_authentication: The official API accepts Token token=<API_TOKEN> and also documents OAuth2 client credentials. The current connection-requirement union cannot perform a client-credentials exchange, so this pack enrolls a connection-owned Authorization header for the complete Token value; an externally minted bearer can also be pasted as that complete header value.
contract_gaps.post_idempotency: The official v3.6 bundle does not document an idempotency request header. POST mutations remain non-idempotent and approval-gated; the pack does not invent a caller header.
contract_gaps.sensitive_responses: Workflow-run, webhook, biometric-token, passkey, and binary-evidence reads can materialize secret or highly sensitive data and are therefore marked sensitive-read. Bundled workflows suppress token and secret fields.
